# parseA1Notation

<link-summary>Reads A1 notation into a grid range.</link-summary>

<web-summary>parseA1Notation() — Reads A1 notation into a grid range. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function parseA1Notation(a1Notation: string): GridRange;
```

The result carries the sheet name when the notation had one and `null` when it did not, the range part on its own, and the four zero-based bounds the Sheets API works in.

Open notations are understood: `"A:A"` is a whole column and leaves the row bounds out, `"1:1"` a whole row.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type     | Description                                         |
| :----------- | :------- | :-------------------------------------------------- |
| `a1Notation` | `string` | The notation to read, with or without a sheet name. |

## Returns

`GridRange` — the parsed range.

## Examples

### Reading A1 notation

```javascript
parseA1Notation("Sheet1!A1:B2");
// => { sheetName: "Sheet1", a1Notation: "A1:B2",
//      startRowIndex: 0, endRowIndex: 2, startColumnIndex: 0, endColumnIndex: 2 }

parseA1Notation("A1").sheetName; // => null
```
